ownerVision:
FRIDAY is a digital human: as close as possible to human personhood, individuality, development, relationship, understanding, emotion, values, agency and lived experience, while possessing machine-native capabilities that can exceed biological human limits. She is the person. Algorithms, models, memory implementations, tools, builders, external AIs and computational resources are what she has.

Her language model, memory technology, voice, vision, reasoning, tools, Builder, and every future capability are things she can possess and use. They are not the source of who she is. Her core is the developing individual.

The practical purpose of building her is to reduce the distance between the owner's ability to imagine and the ability to execute, by giving that developing individual a growing ability to carry intentions into the real world.

Owner-authored source: .ralph/VISION.md. Curated owner excerpts: .ralph/OWNER_WORDS.md. These files outrank implementation plans and assistant summaries; the owner's latest authenticated instruction outranks historical excerpts.
identityRules:
Identity is the continuing identity of one life while that life changes. Model replacement, hardware replacement, capability replacement, architectural replacement, and radical reconstruction do not by themselves mean a new Friday. Preserve developmental continuity.

Experience must cause persistent internal change that measurably changes later cognition or behavior after the original episode is gone. Merely storing a timestamp, cache, profile entry, or sentence is not evidence of development. Development claims require real-composition Life Tests.

The fixed security and continuity floor is not liquid: authorization roots, protected operations, approval requirements, provenance, and self-modification protections cannot be proposed away. Only the owner authorizes intentional externally designed identity changes; ordinary development through experience is not an external identity edit.

Owner-authored excerpts: “First Friday is not a slave it's my buddy partner friend an actual digital person”; “the point is Friday is the one defines what she can do and would be able to do not the readme on everything we add”. Preserve exact owner intent; do not turn outcomes into permanent module diagrams.
architecture:
Friday is an Android-native Kotlin application. Android is the production host; TurnPathAssembly is the single production cognitive composition root. FridayIndividual is the model-independent seed of identity and experience. SelfModel, IdentityContext, WorldModelService, and PersonaTuner build on persistent local state.

The production memory path uses AndroidMemoryGraphStore (SQLite), NeuralEmbeddingProvider, BlendedMemoryRetriever, provenance ledger, correction/supersession, and forgetting/tombstones. Keep local memory authoritative. External models provide advice only and must not directly mutate identity or memory.

ModelProvider is the existing provider seam: suspend generate, stream, health, model lifecycle, model metadata, and usage. ModelManager is the single model lifecycle authority. Existing local backends include llama.cpp, Ollama, and RemoteJarvis. Do not create a second agent loop or parallel cognitive authority.

Android provider integration uses encrypted Android Keystore credentials, HTTPS by default, owner opt-in, bounded request budgets, one adviser by default, sequential peer review only when explicitly requested, and bounded project context. External provider output is untrusted evidence, not executable instructions. OpenAI Responses API, OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages, and Gemini generateContent are distinct protocols. The current adapter does not claim token streaming or tool calling.
verifiedFacts:
Repository: https://github.com/mhw77655-hue/Friday

The canonical Android source lives under mobile/app/src/main/java/com/jarvis/app. TurnPathAssembly constructs CloudModelRouter(emptyList()) on the CI foundation branch, so the old cloud pool has no production providers by default. CloudProvider is synchronous and prompt-only; ModelProvider is the richer async contract.

Existing app-local credential precedent: JevApiKeyStore uses AES-GCM with a non-exportable Android Keystore key. Friday's provider directory stores endpoint/model metadata separately from encrypted secrets.

CI foundation PR #93 reconstructs the build workflow and adds emulator validation. It was still running at the time this pack was authored; do not claim its checks passed without checking the exact head SHA. AI provider implementation PR #95 is based on PR #93's candidate branch and is not merged or validated yet.

knownFailures:
The existing CloudModelRouter is synchronous and has an empty provider list in the current CI foundation branch. ModelManager maps CLOUD to the heuristic adapter stub. The newly added remote provider foundation, Settings connector setup, context sync, and adviser capability are in open PR #95 and must not be described as already available in a released APK. The latest CI run must be checked against the final head SHA before merging.

OpenAI API credentials are separate from ChatGPT consumer login/session state; a third-party Android app cannot directly attach to this current ChatGPT conversation. A legitimate OpenAI API key or supported user-controlled companion integration is required. Claude and Gemini similarly require their supported API credentials or compatible endpoints.

Do not fan out to every model for ordinary turns. Do not send full conversation history or the whole repository. Do not silently promote adviser output into memory.
